context: The prompt requests UI/UX changes to the Active Prompt page, specifically regarding button positions, colors, and behavior. These questions help clarify the specific implementation details and visual design choices for a consistent and user-friendly interface.

questions.question-text: What specific blue color should be used for all buttons?

options.label: Bootstrap primary blue (#0d6efd)
options.pros: Consistent with existing Bootstrap theme, already used in navbar and other UI elements, well-tested for accessibility
options.cons: May not stand out enough from the current design since primary is already in use

options.label: Custom dark blue (#0056b3)
options.pros: More distinctive, better contrast, professional look
options.cons: Deviates from Bootstrap standard, requires custom CSS, needs accessibility testing

options.label: Bootstrap info blue (#0dcaf0)
options.pros: Lighter and more vibrant, good for drawing attention
options.cons: Might be too light for buttons, typically used for informational messages not primary actions

questions.recommendation-rationale: Bootstrap primary blue is recommended because it maintains consistency with the existing color scheme, is already used throughout the interface, and meets accessibility standards. This provides a cohesive user experience without introducing new color values.

questions.question-text: Should execution mode buttons use the same blue color as the action buttons (New, Mod, Complete)?

options.label: Yes, all buttons should be the same blue
options.pros: Unified visual appearance, simple and consistent design, easier to maintain CSS
options.cons: May reduce visual distinction between action buttons and mode selection buttons

options.label: No, execution mode buttons should use a lighter shade of blue
options.pros: Maintains visual hierarchy, helps users distinguish between actions and mode selection, better UX separation
options.cons: Requires additional color definition, slightly more complex CSS

options.label: No, execution mode buttons should remain as outlined buttons with blue borders
options.pros: Clearly separates mode selection from actions, follows Bootstrap button group pattern, less visual weight
options.cons: May not fully meet the prompt requirement of 'all buttons to blue'

questions.recommendation-rationale: The prompt explicitly states 'Change the color of all buttons to blue, including the execution modes buttons', which indicates all buttons should have the same blue color for a unified appearance. This creates a consistent visual language across the entire control panel.

questions.question-text: When should the execution mode be automatically set to 'modification'?

options.label: Immediately when the modification creation API call succeeds
options.pros: Instant feedback, user can immediately see the mode changed, no extra clicks needed
options.cons: Might be unexpected if user wants to review the modification first

options.label: After the modification modal is closed and the modifications list is refreshed
options.pros: Gives user time to see confirmation, more predictable workflow, allows for modal interaction completion
options.cons: Slight delay between creation and mode change

options.label: Only if the user checks an option in the Add Modification modal
options.pros: Gives user control over the behavior, flexible workflow support
options.cons: Adds UI complexity, requires an extra checkbox, may confuse users about the default behavior

questions.recommendation-rationale: Setting the mode after the modal is closed and list is refreshed provides a smoother user experience. It allows the success message to display, the modifications list to update, and then the mode changes - creating a logical workflow sequence that users can follow and understand.

questions.question-text: What should happen to the execution mode success message when mode is changed?

options.label: Remove the showAlert call completely for all execution mode changes
options.pros: Clean interface with no messages, reduces visual noise, silent mode switching
options.cons: User gets no confirmation that mode was changed, might cause confusion if mode change fails silently

options.label: Show a more subtle toast notification instead of the full alert
options.pros: Provides feedback but less intrusive, modern UX pattern, can auto-dismiss quickly
options.cons: Requires implementing toast notification system if not already present

options.label: Update the UI to show mode visually without a message but show errors if mode change fails
options.pros: Best of both worlds - silent on success, alerts only on errors, clean UX for normal operation
options.cons: Users might not notice mode changed if they're not looking at the button group

questions.recommendation-rationale: The prompt specifically states 'Stop showing message when I change the execution mode', which indicates complete removal of the success message. The visual feedback from the radio button selection changing is sufficient confirmation for the user, and errors can still be shown if something goes wrong.

questions.question-text: Where exactly should the Complete button be positioned 'most right on the banner'?

options.label: At the far right end of the entire sticky-controls-panel row
options.pros: Clearly separated from other controls, highly visible, follows common UI pattern of action buttons on the right
options.cons: May create large gap between Mod and Complete buttons if execution modes are in the middle

options.label: Immediately after all execution mode buttons (rightmost position in the control group)
options.pros: Keeps all controls grouped together, maintains cohesion, no large gaps in layout
options.cons: Less emphasis on the Complete button, might not match 'most right on the banner' expectation

options.label: In a separate column/div aligned to the right of the banner
options.pros: Clear visual separation, dedicated space for completion action, flexible for adding more controls
options.cons: Requires more significant HTML restructuring, might look disconnected from other controls

questions.recommendation-rationale: Placing the Complete button at the far right end provides the strongest visual emphasis for this important action. It follows standard UI patterns where primary completion actions are positioned at the rightmost location, making it easy for users to find when they're ready to complete their work.

questions.question-text: Should the Mod button positioning 'after the execution mode statuses group' be before or after the workflow flag icons?

options.label: After the execution mode buttons but before the workflow flags
options.pros: Mod button is still part of the action group, logical placement near New button, maintains button grouping
options.cons: Separates Mod from execution modes which might be related to modifications

options.label: After both the execution mode buttons and their associated workflow flag icons
options.pros: Clear separation between mode selection and actions, Mod button positioned as distinct action
options.cons: May create visual distance from the New button, less obvious grouping with other action buttons

options.label: Integrated as part of the execution mode button group itself
options.pros: Keeps Mod with execution context, reinforces relationship between modifications and execution modes
options.cons: May confuse users as Mod is an action not a mode selection, breaks the button group pattern

questions.recommendation-rationale: The prompt states 'after the execution mode statuses group', which includes both the mode buttons and their status flags. Positioning Mod after this entire group creates a logical flow: action buttons (New), execution mode selection with flags, modification action (Mod), and finally completion action (Complete) at the far right.
